title: Custom Anthropic Messages structured output and native tool protocol

protocolBaseline.structuredOutputs: output_config.format = {type: json_schema, schema} (GA field; output_format deprecated; no beta header); model returns the JSON in the text content block; refusal via stop_reason=refusal; verified against platform.claude.com docs 2026-10-24
